profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Specialties: Apps (Desktop, Mobile, Full Stack), Tools, Automation, 2D & 3D Graphics, UI/UX, Game Development, Automotive Software, Networked Applications, Distributed Data Processing
Languages: C, C++, C#, Python, Java, SQL, Shaders, PowerShell
Technologies: Unity, Godot, DirectX, OpenGL, CMake, Protobuf, ROS, WPF, HERE Maps, Vector Tiles, Databricks, PySpark
Software: MS Visual Studio, VS Code, Android Studio, MS SQL Server, Git, Perforce, 3ds Max, Blender, GIMP
Platforms: Windows, Linux, Android, macOS, iOS, Xbox

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Distributed vehicle telemetry & spatial data platform (Backend Team) 
Skills: Python, PySpark, Databricks, SQL, HERE Maps, OSM Maps, Protobuf, SOME/IP

• Engineered end-to-end pipelines mapping vehicle telemetry onto map features to generate production-ready, multi-tiered analytical datasets
• Developed spatial clustering and map-matching algorithms to derive metrics from vehicle telemetry 
• Built map versioning engine to process global map data, optimize storage, and enable fast retrieval  
• Built ingestion engine to parse and decode vehicle signals (SOME/IP, Protobuf) into structured tables
• Built use-case design engine to map scenario-based vehicle telemetry into domain-specific metrics 
• Optimized distributed pipelines for hundreds of millions of rows with minimal compute and runtime
 
Project: Frontend software (2D & 3D) for Concept Cars with self-driving functionality (HMI Team)
Skills: C++, 3D Graphics, UI/UX, Godot, ROS, HERE Maps, Vector Tiles, Mobileye, CMake, TCP/UDP

• Led development of reusable HMI engine to support visualization of UI/UX, 3D graphics, maps data (SD & HD), perception data, and CAN data for drivable Concept Cars
• Developed data-driven backend to consume data from different map formats (HERE, OpenDRIVE, Mobileye, Vector Tiles) and ADAS systems (Internal, Mobileye) 
• Maintained and developed HMI engine for multiple platforms (Windows, Linux, Android)
• Worked with designers to build HMI apps with complex state flows & animations using HMI engine
• Built client/server system to support HMI apps that interact and persist data across multiple displays
• Integrated & deployed HMI apps for self-driving Concept Cars driven & tested on real roads
• Worked with team to effectively plan, manage, and complete multiple successful projects leading to team growth and recognition across departments
• Mentored engineers on software development stack to help them contribute effectively to projects

positions.title: Senior UX Developer
positions.description:
Project: UI/UX for a fully connected, smart car experience (Future Design Engineering Team)
Skills: C#, Unity3D, Node.js, GIT, API Integration, Mapbox

• Developed UI/UX for a networked, multiscreen car experience focused on a 48-inch wide display
• Worked closely with designers to build apps that utilize the unique integration of the car’s hardware (voice, gesture, cameras, multiscreen) and software to create compelling user experiences
• Built map navigation system with selectable POIs, dynamic zooming, and turn-by-turn directions
• Integrated multilingual voice recognition system to recognize phrases for software interaction

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: 3D graphics engine for mobile AR applications (Computer Vision & Graphics Team)
Skills: C++, Java, Android, Android Studio, Qt, CMake, Git, SWIG, OpenGL, API SDK Development

• Developed new features and APIs for graphics engine and editor tools for developing AR apps
• Refactored major parts of the graphics API for C++/Java interface to support a public SDK release
• Improved text rendering capabilities with bidirectional ordering and text shaping to support complex languages like Arabic in order for AR apps to expand customer base
• Worked with global team to prototype features and investigate/fix issues in engine and AR apps
• Integrated open source libraries into graphics engine, build system tools, and processes
• Awarded the “Engineering Excellence Award Futurewei Technologies 2018” award

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test 2
positions.description:
Project: Forza Motorsport game franchise for Xbox One and PC (Tools & Automation Team)
Skills: C#, SQL, PowerShell, WPF, Entity Framework, Telerik Controls, Xbox One

• Developed and improved existing game content pipeline tools used for monthly release updates
• Wrote robust automation tools to parallelize work on multiple Xboxes to improve efficiency
• Created UI automation framework for automating verification tests of the main game editor tool

Project: Microsoft Photos app for mobile and PC (Performance Team)
Skills: C#, SQL, PowerShell, Cosmos (big data store), Scope (big data SQL), Insights (HTML, Telerik)

• Built infrastructure to automate ETW based performance tests for multiple code branches daily
• Instrumented performance telemetry for Photos app used by millions of customers
• Used Scope to process and transform gigabytes of customer data from Cosmos into SQL
• Developed Insights reports to visualize telemetry in order to detect and improve performance

positions.title: Mobile Game Engineer
positions.description:
Projects: Developed Raucous and Furious Football mobile games released for Android and iOS
Skills: C#, iOS, Android, Unity3D

• Built client / server game engine that supports multiplayer via Wi-Fi and mobile data (3G, 4G, etc.)
• Wrote infrastructure to improve productivity: crash handler, in-game profiler, and logging system
• Created memory pooling system to control fragmentation and improve performance in C# code
• Wrote flexible AI system to create AI by mixing a set of unique behaviors and prioritizing them
• Integrated Unity3D and 3rd party plugins (Game Center, Google Play, animations, physics, etc.)
• Worked with team to write specs, track work, implement gameplay, integrate art, and fix bugs

positions.title: Software Development Engineer 2
positions.description:
Project: Built a bug stat and trend reporting application for all 1st party Xbox game projects
Skills: C#, Silverlight, SQL, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, WCF RIA, Telerik, IIS

• Built a 3-tier application using a website client (Silverlight), server (WCF RIA), and database (SQL)
• Wrote installer to deploy the 3-tier application, which reduced errors and simplified deployment
• Wrote WCF RIA web services and used Entity Framework, LINQ to Entities and SQL for data access
• Created a widget plug-in system that allowed the application to evolve with new functionality
• Developed widgets with Telerik chart and grid controls to show data with customizable options

positions.title: Game Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Built a 3D game engine from the ground up to showcase advance game technology
Skills: C++, PC, DirectX 9.0, OpenGL 2.0, 3ds Max, Cg Shaders, WPF

• Implemented Phong lighting, normal mapping, sky boxes, heightmap terrain, animation skinning
• Wrote custom memory manager that allowed memory to be defragged in real time
• Built a record, replay, and rewind system that can save / restore game state in real time
• Created WPF editor tool that runs game engine in a WPF control allowing cross-app interaction
• Wrote math library that supports vectors, matrices, quaternions, and 3D transformations
• Wrote component-based entity system that exposed editable properties via a custom RTTI system
• Created graphics engine that supports real time switching between DirectX and OpenGL

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test
positions.description:
Project: Halo Waypoint (Services Team), developed and launched with Xbox, web, and mobile apps
Skills: C#, C++, WPF, SQL, PowerShell, Visual Studio Test, IIS, Hyper-V, WCF, LINQ, Xbox 360, XLSP

• Deployed, maintained, debugged, and developed test infrastructure for a scalable n-tier app involving multiple machines (Security Gateway, Client, Server, Database, CDN, Load Balancer)
• Wrote and maintained hundreds of unit tests for client API (C++) and server-side (C#) code
• Developed automation for running unit tests and reporting results using a distributed build farm

Projects: Forza 2, Halo 3, Halo ODST, and Halo Reach games for Xbox 360
Skills: C#, C++, WPF, Xbox 360

• Owned major test areas by writing specs, creating test, managing bugs, and developing tools
• Managed QA testers to execute tests, use tools, and write bugs with high efficiency and reliability

positions.title: Game Scripter (Internship)
positions.description:
Project: Project H.A.M.M.E.R. game for the Nintendo Wii

• Scripted game logic for player, AI, and environmental objects using in-house game engine tools
• Worked with team to implement gameplay, integrate art, and make changes on feedback
